correctness.rationale: Exact proof: the classical divided-power recurrence gives P(1)^p=0; valuation detects precisely (t^ceil(N/p)); triangular leading-degree basis gives a k[a]-linear projection to k[a] for every permitted a; truncated integration has invertible denominators since its nilpotence index is <=p; composition is weight-zero RB and realizes a; algebraic entries vary regularly on each valuation stratum. All domain assumptions and boundary cases a=0, p=2, r=N-1 are included. Checker exercises 1204 explicit constructions and five exhaustive tiny-dimensional matrix classifications; finite checks only support the proof.

value.rationale: Unit evaluation is a natural structural coordinate of the RB operator space; the p-power obstruction alone leaves an existence gap. Proving the converse for every nonlinear truncated jet and all p,N,k, with explicit regular sections on each valuation stratum, supplies a complete, dimension-unbounded image classification and exact q-power arithmetic distribution. The module-theoretic splitting is substantive and goes beyond a low-dimensional census or a routine rephrasing of the classical factorial obstruction.
